title: Callvale before: scheduled jobs on the worker
claim: One worker instance runs the conversions and the small scheduled jobs, so a busy worker stops them all.
alt: Before: the web tier sends each upload to the one worker instance and waits. On the worker, scheduled jobs register uploads, save results and send notifications. The worker writes job status to the PostgreSQL database. The worker is marked as overloaded.

edges.label: upload
edges.say: The web tier sends each upload to the one worker instance.

edges.label: also runs
edges.say: Scheduled jobs on the worker register uploads, save results and send notifications.

edges.label: job status
edges.say: On launch day the conversions fill the worker, and the small jobs stop too.
